errors.text_span: The chart features four groups of bars, each representing a different SFT configuration: no SFT (blue), + SFT on D0 (yellow), + SFT on D0, D1 (purple), and + SFT on D0, D1, D2 (red). For each model variant, the bars are arranged in ascending order of SFT configurations.
errors.evidence: The bars are stacked, not grouped. The description incorrectly describes the arrangement as grouped.

errors.text_span: 87% for LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B with + SFT on D0, D1, D2
errors.evidence: The figure shows the red bar (SFT on D0, D1, D2) for LLaMA-2-13B at approximately 80% and for LLaMA-2-70B at close to 80%, not 87%.
The figure shows the blue bar (no SFT) for LLaMA-2-7B at approximately 66%, not 65%.

errors.text_span: The approximate CoLeG-R percentages for the shortest and tallest bars are 65% for LLaMA-2-7B with no SFT and 87% for LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B with + SFT on D0, D1, D2
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the shortest and tallest bars. The tallest bar for LLaMA-2-7B is the red bar (SFT on D0, D1, D2) at ~82%, not the purple or red bars for LLaMA-2-13B or LLaMA-2-70B.
The description does not mention the specific visual patterns (e.g., diagonal stripes, horizontal stripes, slanted stripes) of the bars.

errors.text_span: The bar chart illustrates the effect of scaling up model scales and Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) datasets on the performance of LLaMA-2 models, specifically measuring the CoLeG-R percentage.
errors.evidence: The description introduces interpretation ('effect of scaling up') not explicitly shown in the figure. The figure only shows CoLeG-R percentages under different conditions without implying causality or effect.

errors.text_span: No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining, and no specific sorting beyond the SFT configurations is applied.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states no visual emphasis, but the distinct color patterns and textures serve as visual emphasis. Also, the description overgeneralizes by stating 'no specific sorting' without acknowledging the grouping by model type.
